column1: Story defects found while writing the build notes
116 contradictions inside the Epic 1, Epic 2 and technical enabler stories, found by reading every flow step against the rest of its own story. Most need a ruling before the squad builds that story.

column3: What contradicts what

RWB-E1-066 step 1 and AC1: the interaction carries promise amount and promise date, but the section 12 InteractionRequest lists only channel, direction, result and summary
RWB-E2-031 header: title tag [E3d] against epic E2, release 31 December 2026

RWB-E2-017 steps 8 and 9: section 12 contracts the send as POST /treatments/{treatmentId}/signature-requests, while section 13 components and TC-E2-017-14 name POST /cases/{caseId}/generated-documents/send

step says 53 foreign keys, section 13 adds a further foreign key from sys_objects.data_product to data_product.product_code

the flow runs MaskingVerifier before the files are loaded into the staging schema, while section 13 build step 4 runs it after the load into recovery_next

section 12 returns MSG-P4-003 when a delivery is not found, while section 14 gives MSG-P4-003 the text about a case not being in the reader's scope

section 9 moves the case to EXCEPTION_QUEUE when the decision log write fails, while X4 and AC6 say the case stays in its state, NEW

the refusal message in AC13 says the previous load is still in use, but the Background gives LIT-07 the status LISTED, so this tracker has no earlier load to keep using.
the criterion keeps the 5 cases in queue TDR-BKK-CO with no owner, while the message MSG-P3-011 that it sends the team manager says the cases are waiting in the overflow queue
the criterion sets RWB_SCHEMA to rwb_case in DEV and SIT, while section 3 of the same story assumes the value recovery in every environment
the criterion says the system files the report with the release checklist, while section 4 step 9 gives that filing to the Tribe lead and section 12 makes the report endpoint read only.
the criterion expects a menu of the screens the case owner role can read, while section 15 says Epic 1 has no business screens.
the job has run past its threshold and has not failed, but MSG-P2-004 in section 14 reads "{job} failed at {time}".

the DP06 stamp has business date 2026-11-23 with load time on 2026-11-24, while the Background weekly cycle (expected by Monday 08:00) and AC8 have the DP06 load commit on its Monday business date at 04:40.
the criterion keeps DQ07 out of the run on 2026-11-30 although its valid to date is 2026-11-30, while exception path X5 holds a rule back only once its valid to date has passed.

the criterion needs the access load to check role codes against the roles table, as exception path X2 and section 11 do, while sections 13 and 17 say the story reads no role table and takes role codes from the session.
the criterion raises no task for an event with no case, while exception path X8 gives that case message MSG-P2-001, which section 14 defines as the text of the exception queue task.
section 3 says the interface configuration rows for INT-15 are already loaded, while AC1 has a developer adding the INT-15 file load as new.
AC4 gives the next case number as RW-2026-000124 on 2026-12-16, but AC8 says RW-2026-000125 was already issued on 2026-12-01.
AC2, AC5 and AC6 call POST /admin/break-glass, while section 12 defines the endpoint as POST /admin/break-glass-grants.
the scenario is titled "Hash chain verified daily", while section 19 puts the nightly schedule of the chain check and its daily report out of scope for this story (RWB-TE-008, JOB-14).

the scenario says no SERVICE_LEVEL version is in force on 2026-12-01, while the Background of the same feature states the SERVICE_LEVEL row for "HIRE_PURCHASE" and "ASSIGNED" is 5 working days with warning percent 80.
the scenario says "refdata.cache.ttl-seconds" has no value and no default for UAT, while section 3 lists that parameter in the catalog seed file with default 300.
the failed run covers business date 2 December 2026 per the Background, yet the scenario gives 2 December 2026 as the date of the last complete check reported in MSG-P7-013.
the scenario requires one MSG-P7-008 report naming both entry IDs, while section 14 defines MSG-P7-008 with a single {entryId} placeholder.
